lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spatial arrangement consists of a primary grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized into four horizontal tiers posterior to the branchial region, transitioning to a higher density of smaller, disorganized clusters towards the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at regular intervals, forming a checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear trajectories are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, defined by a luminance step-function showing an abrupt transition from high-intensity highlights to low-intensity shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance clusters in a non-uniform, low-density spatial distribution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized cluster of red-wavelength pixels is situated on the lower-mid flank, contrasting with the surrounding gray and white tonal range of the skin pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior cranial region exhibits a vermiculated pattern where high-luminance pixels form non-linear, branching structures instead of discrete circular blobs.
